chunks: It glows and burns the skin.

key_terms.لِلْبَشَرِ: For the skin / of the human body

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says Hellfire glows and burns the skin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Muddaththir highlights the tangible, physical nature of Hellfire, countering dualistic views that might spiritualize punishment. The term 'Lawah' implies a glowing, scorching heat that penetrates the skin, serving as a vivid reminder of divine justice for those who rejected the message. This description underscores the corporeal reality of the afterlife, a key tenet in Shia theological discussions on resurrection.
